lint.command: uv run ruff check packages/vkg && uv run ruff format --check packages/vkg

test.command: COVERAGE_FILE=packages/vkg/.coverage uv run pytest packages/vkg -m unit -v --tb=short --cov=packages/vkg --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml:packages/vkg/coverage.xml --cov-fail-under=80 --junitxml=packages/vkg/junit.xml
